description:
Cast Repeated Reverberation by paying {2}{R}{R}, copying the next instant or sorcery spell you cast twice.
Cast Croaking Counterpart by paying {1}{G}{U}, targeting Biovisionary.
Repeated Reverberation triggers, copying Croaking Counterpart twice, with both copies targeting Biovisionary.
Resolve all Croaking Counterparts, creating three token copies of Biovisionary that are 1/1 Frogs.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.
